# Files that name a provider host: ghcr.io, github.com, api.github.com, googleapis.com, amazonaws.com, r2.cloudflarestorage.com.
# One path or glob per line with a reason. the shared `seams` check fails an entry that matches no file with a host.
internal/gitcred/forgeapp/forgeapp.go # default API base URL of the GitHub App credential
charts/ward/Chart.yaml # home and source URL of this project
charts/ward/values.yaml # default image repository of the published image
.github/workflows/*.yml # workflows run on GitHub and publish to its registry and releases
